annotation.title_clean: ISO/PAS 23735:2025 Road vehicles — Ergonomic design guidance for external visual communication from automated vehicles to other road users
annotation.title_en: ISO/PAS 23735:2025 Road vehicles — Ergonomic design guidance for external visual communication from automated vehicles to other road users
annotation.summary_en: ISO catalogue page for ISO/PAS 23735:2025, giving ergonomic design guidance for external visual communication from L4/L5 automated driving system-dedicated vehicles to other road users, covering cars, trucks and buses in varied domains and for diverse users. Published March 2025 by ISO/TC 22/SC 39.
key_provisions_or_claims: Scope covers external visual communication of single-mode L4/L5 ADS-dedicated vehicles per SAE J3016
Applies to passenger cars, commercial vehicles, buses and derivatives, with or without occupant compartments
Covers open roads, motorways, urban, geo-fenced areas, ports and terminals
Considers diverse road users including elderly, disabled people and children
Published March 2025 as a Publicly Available Specification
